Adele, Akeron, Argus, Bayle, Eden, Ikra, Kaelen, Legion, Maco, Mourn, N3ON, Scarlett and Valmont.

The Void is a brand new personal sale, made just for you. When it opens, you’ll reveal 5 skins picked from the Heroes you play, each with its own discount of up to 70% off.
Your picks: skins are chosen from the Heroes you’ve played recently, then the ones you’ve played the most. You’ll never be offered a skin you already own.
Your discounts: every skin gets a discount between 20% and 70%.
Two weeks to decide: The Void stays open for 2 weeks, with a countdown on the main menu. You’ll get a notification when it opens.
Don’t own the Hero? You can buy the Hero and the skin together.
The Void is available to players level 10 and above.
The Void will start opening during V1.18, in batches, so not everyone will get theirs at the same time. Keep an eye on the main menu, and when it does open: don’t stare too long.

V1.18: Frostbite brings big changes to the top of the Ranked ladder. There's a brand new tier, Paragon now belongs to the very best of the best, and players who stay in the fight lose much less VP when a teammate goes AFK. For the full story, check out our blog, The Road to Paragon: Ranked in 1.18 and Beyond.
Split 5 ends on Tuesday 3rd November with the release of V1.18, so be sure to get your peak Rank this weekend and lock in your end of Split rewards.

Finishing Placements will get you the Split 5 Icon and Banner for your peak Rank. If you win 15 games, you will unlock the Royal Wukong skin, with additional variants if your peak Rank was Gold or higher.
Bronze and Silver: Royal Wukong.
Gold: Royal Wukong, plus the Gold variant.
Platinum: Royal Wukong, plus the Gold and Platinum variants.
Diamond: Royal Wukong, plus the Gold, Platinum and Diamond variants.
Paragon: Royal Wukong, plus all variants (Gold, Platinum, Diamond and Paragon).
All players will start the new split in Placements and have 5 matches to complete to get placed (10 if you're new to Ranked or haven't played in a while).
V1.18 adds a brand new tier towards the top of the ladder: Master, sitting between Diamond I and Paragon.
Promotion game: when you reach the top of Diamond I, you'll play a promotion game to earn your place in Master.
No VP cap: once you're in Master, your VP keeps climbing as long as you keep winning.
Wins and losses in Master are +11 / -11 VP.
Paragon should be the ultimate achievement: the rank people recognise the moment they see it in the lobby. From V1.18, only 100 players can be Paragon at any one time.
Once you gain 200+ VP in Master, you're eligible for the Top 100. There's no promotion game: earn as much VP as you can to claim your spot.
The Top 100 refreshes every 24 hours. If you're still in the Top 100 at the refresh, you keep Paragon. If not, you're back in Master.
The only way to lose Paragon early is to be demoted to Diamond.
The first time you hit Paragon, you'll get a notification, whether that's on login, on the leaderboard or right after the match that got you there.
